import json
# tie_burst: check tie overtakes are exercised and certificate holds
o=json.load(open("tie_burst.out"))
tot_tie=sum(d["tie_overtakes"] for d in o["departures"])
tot_cmp=sum(d["comparable"] for d in o["departures"])
print("tie_burst: departures", len(o["departures"]), "ticks", o["ticks"], "idle", o["idle"],
      "tie_sum", tot_tie, "cmp_sum", tot_cmp, "rank_err_sum", sum(d["rank_error"] for d in o["departures"]))
for rg in o["ranges"]:
    if sum(rg["counts"]): print("  nonempty range counts", rg["counts"], "bound", rg["bound"], "observed", rg["observed"])
    else: assert rg["bound"]==0 and rg["observed"]==0
assert o["ticks"]-o["idle"]==120000
# big stream consistency
s=json.load(open("big_stream.out"))
f=s["final"]
res=sum(len(q) for q in f["queues"])
print("big_stream: events", len(s["events"]), "attempted", f["totals"]["attempted"],
      "accepted", f["totals"]["accepted"], "departed", f["totals"]["departed"], "residents", res,
      "dropped", f["totals"]["dropped"], "idle", f["totals"]["idle"])
assert f["totals"]["accepted"]==f["totals"]["departed"]+res
assert f["totals"]["attempted"]==120000
# events sizes consistent with final queues
last_sizes=s["events"][-1]["sizes"]
assert last_sizes==[len(q) for q in f["queues"]], (last_sizes, [len(q) for q in f["queues"]])
# check every event's sizes sum equals accepted-departed at that point
acc=0; dep=0
for ev in s["events"]:
    acc+=sum(1 for a in ev["arrivals"] if a["accepted"])
    if ev["service"] and ev["service"]["packet"]: dep+=1
    assert sum(ev["sizes"])==acc-dep, (ev["t"], sum(ev["sizes"]), acc-dep)
print("big_stream per-event size accounting OK; updates:",
      sum(1 for ev in s["events"] if ev["update"]))
print("final borders len", len(f["borders"]), "weights", f["weights"])
EOF
